params.name: _page
params.description:
The page of results to return.
The first page is page number 1.

params.name: _limit
params.description: The number of results returned per page.

params.name: _sortBy
params.description: Sorts results according to the specified field.

params.name: _order
params.description: The sort order (ascending / descending) of the field specified by the `_sortBy` parameter.

params.name: _search
params.description:
A search filter that is applied to all fields.
Only results that contain the specified string are returned.

params.name: _format
params.description: The format of returned results.

params.name: orgId
params.description: ID of your ControlUp organization. You can find your organization ID on the [API Key Management page](how-to-make-api-requests#how-to-find-your-controlup-organization-id) in the DEX platform.

params.name: childOrganizationId
params.description:
Filter roles by a specific tenant manager child organization ID.
Returns roles that apply to this child organization (either roles with no specific child organizations, or roles that include this child organization).

params.name: isDefault
params.description: A search filter on the `isDefault` field.

params.name: description
params.description: A search filter on the `description` field.

params.name: name

params.name: id
params.description:
ID of the role to retrieve. You can use [GET /roles](orgrolespubliccontroller_getall) to see the ID of each role.

Default role IDs:
* Admin - 1
* Editor - 2
* Viewer - 3
* No Permissions - 4
* VDI and DaaS Admins - 5
* Access Real-Time DX Console - 6

items.docs: Returns the details for a role, including the permissions within the role and the users to which the role is assigned.
